comment: `_aeroelast` is the compiled PyO3 extension installed by `maturin develop`.
It ships no `.pyi`, so a checker resolving the `.so` cannot know its members
and reports every `from _aeroelast import X` as an unknown symbol -- six test
modules plus `src/aeroelast/solvers` and `src/aeroelast/models` import from it.
`typings/_aeroelast.pyi` declares that surface loosely so the names resolve and
a typo in an import is still caught.
This file is the canonical pyright configuration: pyright reads it in
preference to `[tool.pyright]` in `pyproject.toml`, so the setting lives here
